title: NASA attempt to read the Ramey memo with algorithms

tellings.quote: So we actually wrote the algorithms to actually read this memo.

plain: Between 2000 and 2003, a team at NASA's Intelligent Systems Division wrote computer algorithms to try to read the Ramey memo, a document whose writing is hard to make out and which UFO researchers have long tried to decipher. Kevin Knuth, who was there and calls himself a NASA whistleblower, tells Michels: "we actually wrote the algorithms to actually read this memo." Why it matters to him is that people inside NASA were quietly working on a UFO document.
